descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为500。

 > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limits

Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 500 queries per second (QPS) to call this API operation.

 > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
